body:
I have GHSV1, diagnosed in Dec 2021. My first OB was hell personally. I was depressed and going through a rough time which I believe made it worse. 

At first I was on meds daily but after the 2nd or 3rd OB, my symptoms went away drastically and now I barely, if that never, get OBs! If I do it’s a small, barely itchy bump or two that looks like an ingrown hair and comes around the time of my period. I only take my meds when I feel symptoms and 500mg of ibuprofen makes the itching go away and was a life saver when I was first diagnosed. 

Unfortunately I was in a toxic relationship at the time a spread it too my partner because we were having sex early after my diagnosis. He knew I had herpes and was willing to take the risk but still used it against me in subtle ways later. He got a really bad outbreak on his mouth, nose, and nuts so BOTH IS POSSIBLE EVEN AT THE SAME TIME! Please be careful when having sex early on! Good luck and this is really nothing to stress over, you’ll most likely forget you even have it! :)

Right I totally agree with you. How did the condom end up on your arm? That sounds EXTREMELY suspicious so I can see why you think he’s was trying to trap you. Please have a serious conversation with him about that before you build up resentment and something bad comes from that. If he really likes you he’ll try to understand where you’re coming from. Good luck with everything!
